text:
Liam: Hey finance, I pre-paid a conference booth deposit on the corporate card yesterday. Vendor invoice attached but the invoice total is in EUR while the card charge posted in USD. Vendor PDF also missing VAT reg number and their PO number doesn't match our PO 80072. How should I record this?

Sofia: Can you paste the invoice link and the card transaction screenshot? We need transaction currency, posted amount, and vendor invoice total to reconcile FX.

Liam: Invoice: https://files.redwood.example/invoices/booth-deposit-evex2026.pdf Card txn: https://files.redwood.example/bank/card_tx_2034758901.png Invoice shows 000.00 EUR, card posted at $2190.00 (USD) on 2026-03-25. Vendor PO listed is VP-9001, our PO is 80072. I asked vendor to confirm PO mapping.

Marta: Okay. Two parallel issues: (1) currency reconciliation (EUR invoice vs USD card charge + bank FX fee), (2) PO mismatch / missing VAT info. For recording: create expense with the invoice amount in EUR, add a separate FX variance line to capture the difference when the card posts in USD. Attach both invoice and card txn.

Accounts Payable: Automated note: Required docs for vendor prepay -> original vendor invoice, vendor remit confirmation, vendor VAT reg no (if reclaimable), matching PO or written exception from procurement. Missing: vendor VAT reg no, PO match. If vendor refuses to provide VAT reg no, classify as non-reclaimable and code GL 6552.

Liam: Vendor replied: they only issued invoices in EUR and said the posted USD amount depends on the cardholder bank. They provided an email confirming VP-9001 maps to our PO 80072 and offered a corrected invoice if we supply our PO reference to them. Email: https://files.redwood.example/outbox/vendor_reply_EVEX.eml

Sofia: Good. Ask them to reissue invoice with: (1) our PO 80072 on the invoice, (2) vendor VAT reg no, (3) billing address = Redwood Inference Ltd. If they cant reissue, get written confirmation mapping VP-9001 -> 80072 and vendor VAT reg number in the email thread.

Marta: For the booking, please create two ledger entries in the expense portal:
- Line A: Booth deposit 000.00 EUR 000.00 EUR (currency field = EUR) 000.00 vendor invoice attached 000.00 tag GL: 7201 000.00 PO: 80072 (pending vendor reissue)
- Line B: FX variance / card posting difference = $2190.00 - euro-converted amount at bank rate (attach card txn) 000.00 tag GL: 8999 (FX gains/losses)
Also mark expense as "prepaid vendor" and flag for AP follow-up.

Accounts Payable: Note: If the vendor reissues in EUR with VAT reg no, AP will attempt VAT reclaim where applicable. If they cannot provide VAT reg no, mark as non-reclaimable and notify Procurement for vendor onboarding issue.

Liam: Submitted the expense as instructed: https://expenses.redwood.example/submit/2034758901 I attached the vendor email mapping and card screenshot.

Sofia: One more: procurement approval required for PO mismatch. @Marta please confirm exception or escalate to procurement.

Marta: I'll approve pending vendor reissue. If vendor doesn't reissue within 5 business days, I'll open a ticket with Procurement for a formal exception and vendor remediation.

finance-bot: Thread summary: next steps = vendor reissue requested -> expense recorded with EUR invoice + FX variance line -> AP to reconcile VAT once vendor provides VAT reg no -> procurement exception if no reissue within 5 business days. Thread closed by finance-bot.
